Hi Samantha,

Thanks again for your time today — good discussion. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed next step: convene a short steering committee / exec sponsor session to align on decision criteria and procurement path.

Key points from the call:
- Decision criteria: latency p95 target <250ms, target cost per 1M tokens, private VPC requirement, audit logging + SOC 2 evidence
- Most likely economic buyer: Tom Harris (CPO) — will want an initial cost + ROI summary
- Procurement: Michelle Grant (procurement) will drive contract/terms and timeline
- Legal: need to confirm which in-house counsel will be involved for DPA and security terms

Proposed steering committee meeting (45 minutes): agenda to cover architecture overview, performance/cost estimates, rollout & timeline, procurement milestones. Proposed slots (Pacific time):
- Tue Oct 20, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Oct 21, 14:00–14:45

Attachments: 20261018-Roadmap-and-ROI-presentation.pdf; SOW-draft-20261018.docx (high level).

Can you confirm who will attend from Fintegrate (exec sponsor + procurement + legal) and which slot works? Once we have attendees and a slot, we'll send a calendar invite and a 1-page pre-read.

Thanks,

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Steering committee — security checklist and pre-read

Hi all,

Thanks Marissa and Samantha. Attached is a short security checklist and a one-page SOC 2 scope summary that should cover what your security team will want to see ahead of the steering committee. Highlights:

- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified (covering security and availability) — we will share the report under NDA; key controls for data access, encryption at rest/in transit, and incident response are documented.
- Data residency: support for VPC/private deployments and optional customer-managed KMS
- Audit logs: per-request audit logging and retention policy (configurable)
- Data retention & deletion processes — standard 30/90/365 options or custom terms for enterprise

Attachments: Fintegrate-Security-Checklist.xlsx; SOC2-Summary-2026.pdf

If Fintegrate legal wants the SOC 2 report, we can coordinate an NDA and share it via secure link. For the meeting, I suggest we have a 10-minute security segment and allocate time for procurement questions at the end.

Samantha — does that cover what you need for your security and procurement leads?

Best,

Rishi Malhotra
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
